messages.author: b54227638a9f2196
messages.subject: Special characters in \Sexpr
parts:
Dear knitr users.

I got an error when using inline function with knitr related to the "_" character.

For instance:

\Sexpr{'my_function()'}

will generate an error.

I was wondering is there was a workaround to fix this.

With regards,
Philippe

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Special characters in \Sexpr
parts:
_ is a special character in LaTeX, and must be escaped. Try
\Sexpr{'my\\_function()'}

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Special characters in \Sexpr
parts:
Well, you should not set up the `inline` hook function, because this
hook function will escape special characters, which means the
underscore _ was first escaped by you manually as \_, then hi_latex()
escaped it to \textbackslash{}_, which certainly won't work. Do either
way, but not both.

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name
